mode.description: `animation` animates the reference character with the driving motion. `replacement` replaces the driving subject with the reference character while keeping the original scene.

driving_type.description: Driving signal for animation mode. `end_to_end` (default) drives directly from the SAM3-masked driving video and is the recommended, most robust path. `pose` renders an explicit NLF/DWPose skeleton from the driving video (more control for challenging inputs).

examples: A person dancing gracefully in a sunlit studio
prompt.description: The prompt describing the final video to generate.

image_url.description: URL of the reference character image. The character in this image is animated (or used to replace a subject) according to the driving video.

num_inference_steps.description: Number of diffusion sampling steps. Higher improves quality but is slower.

resolution.description: Output resolution. 512p outputs 896x512 (landscape) or 512x896 (portrait); 704p outputs 1280x704 or 704x1280. Orientation is chosen automatically from the reference image aspect ratio.

shift.description: Flow-matching noise schedule shift. 3.0 is recommended for the 512p tier.

seed.description: Random seed. Leave empty for a random seed. The seed used is returned in the response.

guidance_scale.description: Classifier-free guidance scale. Controls prompt adherence versus creativity.

subject_type.description: Type of subject in the driving video. `animal` switches the SAM3 detection prompt to non-human subjects.

video_url.description: URL of the driving (motion) video. The subject can be a human, multiple humans, or an animal.
